INSERT INTO customer (name, email, phone, region_code, birth_date, joined_at, total_purchase, email_consent_yn, email_consent_at, sms_consent_yn, sms_consent_at, source) VALUES
(#{r.f.name}, #{r.f.email}, #{r.f.phone}, #{r.f.regionCode}, #{r.f.birthDate}, #{r.f.joinedAt}, #{r.totalPurchase}, #{r.emailYn}, CASE WHEN #{r.emailYn} = 'Y' THEN now() END, #{r.smsYn}, CASE WHEN #{r.smsYn} = 'Y' THEN now() END, 'UPLOAD')

INSERT INTO consent_history (customer_id, channel, before_yn, after_yn, source) SELECT customer_id, 'EMAIL', NULL, 'Y', 'UPLOAD' FROM customer WHERE deleted_yn = 'N' AND email_consent_yn = 'Y' AND email IN #{e} UNION ALL SELECT customer_id, 'SMS', NULL, 'Y', 'UPLOAD' FROM customer WHERE deleted_yn = 'N' AND sms_consent_yn = 'Y' AND email IN #{e}
mapper.update: UPDATE customer SET name = COALESCE(#{r.f.name}, name), phone = COALESCE(#{r.f.phone}, phone), region_code = COALESCE(#{r.f.regionCode}, region_code), birth_date = COALESCE(#{r.f.birthDate}::date, birth_date), joined_at = #{r.f.joinedAt}, email_consent_yn = #{r.emailYn}, email_consent_at = CASE WHEN #{r.emailYn} = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(CASE WHEN email_consent_yn = 'Y' THEN email_consent_at END, now()) END, sms_consent_yn = #{r.smsYn}, sms_consent_at = CASE WHEN #{r.smsYn} = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(CASE WHEN sms_consent_yn = 'Y' THEN sms_consent_at END, now()) END, updated_at = now() WHERE customer_id = #{r.customerId} AND deleted_yn = 'N'
